question: A LangGraph application stores custom Python objects in state. The checkpoint is written successfully, but after process restart the restored value is a plain structure rather than the original custom type, causing application code to fail only after resume. Explain the serialization/deserialization path through JsonPlusSerializer, how type metadata is encoded and reconstructed, when pickle or msgpack fallbacks are involved, how serializer configuration controls which Python types can be reconstructed, and why the failure can appear during resumed execution rather than at the moment the checkpoint was created.
